entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I get your name and the order number?
The name is Alex Chen. Order is VF1138-C.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order right here for the Pro-Ride Helmet, delivered nine days ago. To get started, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference?
It's the color. It looked different online. The box is unopened, still sealed.

I understand. Getting the right gear is essential, especially when it comes to an item for your safety. I'm happy to tell you that the helmet is well within our 90-day return policy, so I can process this for you right away.

Okay, I've just initiated the return. I'm also emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. And since I see you're a VIP member with us, I've waived the standard restocking fee and included a 15% off coupon in that email for your next purchase.
Whatever. I just need the label.

Of course. The email has been sent. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse scans it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Alex. Have a good day.
